description: INT-002: the transistor radio is switched on. LOCAL — one viewer's radio is not the room's, and this never reaches the scheduler. The beat is authored rather than coded so the order reads as a real set: the switch clicks, the dial warms, and the station arrives a beat later, because valve-era electronics do not start instantly and a station that arrives WITH the click reads as a sound effect. Until AUD-B01 (#56) lands there is no licensable music to play, so the station is a synthesised original — see tools/audio.js.
